resources.string: Pair this debug app with your computer in KDE Connect first. Your official app keeps its own pairing.
Computer offline. Your draft is saved; reconnect before sending.
Remote input is unavailable or disabled on the computer. Check its KDE Connect settings.
Microphone allowed. Press the microphone again to start.
Microphone permission is required. Allow it in app permissions, or use voice typing in your keyboard.
Text queued. Draft kept for recovery; Enter was not sent.
Listening · release or tap to finish
Tap to start / tap again to stop
The system service may stop on silence or use cloud recognition. Bluetooth microphone routing depends on that service. Keyboard voice typing also works below.
Voice results appear here. You can also type or use your keyboard’s microphone.
Screenshot opens Windows snipping. Select the area with your mouse, then tap Paste when ready.
No system speech service. Use your keyboard’s voice typing in the preview field.
No speech recognized. Try the microphone again; your draft is unchanged.
Speech service network error. Try again or use keyboard voice typing.
Speech service does not support the current language or its model is missing.
Microphone unavailable. Check other recording apps and retry.
Speech service busy. Wait a moment, then retry.
Recognition failed or timed out. Press the microphone to retry.
Device selection changed. Check the target before sending.
